versions.headline: 賓福特主場看高一線，森林入球乏力但 xG 不差

versions.headline: 切爾西主場稍佔優，但兩隊狀態都差，打和機會不低，只供參考
reasons: 切爾西主場兼排名較高，市場和統計模型都給主勝約五成多；不過切爾西聯賽連輸兩場，主場0-2負熱刺，週三聯賽盃作客利物浦打足120分鐘再互射十二碼出局，體力是隱憂
切爾西後防傷兵多： Lacroix、James、Martinez 缺陣，Hato也確定缺席，Chavarría可以復出頂上左閘；加上 Joao Pedro 不在，鋒線主要靠 Welbeck 和 Palmer
曼聯近況極差（聯賽主場0-3負般尼茅夫，歐聯1-4負Como），Sesko 長期缺陣，Rashford 成疑；不過 Carrick 面臨下課壓力，曼聯會拼盡全力，而且對賽紀錄曼聯4勝4和2負，不怕切爾西
球證 Bankes 平均每場4.6黃牌、24次犯規，曼聯落後時會搏得更凶，黃牌和犯規估計偏多；角球方面切爾西主場應佔較多控球，所以角球估計略多於模型
versions.headline_en: Chelsea slight home favourites, but both sides are in poor form and a draw is very possible. Reference only.
reasons_en: Chelsea are at home and higher in the table, and both the market and the model give them a win chance in the low-to-mid 50s. But they have lost two league games in a row, including 0-2 at home to Spurs, and played 120 minutes plus penalties at Anfield in the Carabao Cup on Wednesday, so fatigue is a worry.

Chelsea's defence is badly hit by injuries: Lacroix, James and Martinez are out, and Hato is confirmed absent too. Chavarria is back and can fill in at left-back. With Joao Pedro out, the attack relies mainly on Welbeck and Palmer.

United's form is awful (0-3 at home to Bournemouth, 1-4 to Como in the UCL). Sesko is out long-term and Rashford is doubtful. But Carrick's job is under threat, so United will throw everything at this game, and their head-to-head record is good (4 wins, 4 draws, 2 losses).

Referee Bankes averages 4.6 yellow cards and 24 fouls per game, and United will get more aggressive if they fall behind, so cards and fouls should run high. Chelsea should have more of the ball at home, so their corner count is set a bit above the model.

versions.headline: 切爾西主場稍佔優，但無正選中鋒加體力隱憂，和局機會不低
reasons: 切爾西正式首發沒有正選中鋒，前線是 Estêvão、Palmer、Rogers；Joao Pedro 缺陣，入球效率成疑
切爾西週三聯賽盃打足120分鐘，聯賽又連輸兩場，主場0-2負熱刺時 xG 只有0.47
曼聯 Rashford 不在首發，Šeško 缺陣，但 Fernandes、Cunha、Mbeumo 齊上，反擊有威脅，對賽紀錄亦佔上風
球證 Bankes 平均每場4.6黃牌、24次犯規，賽事膠著，黃牌估計約5張
versions.key_changes: 主勝由51%下調至44%，貼近市場：首發確認切爾西沒有正選中鋒、由年輕門將 Penders 把關，加上週中打了120分鐘，體力有隱憂；曼聯客勝由24%升至30%。
versions.headline_en: Chelsea slight home edge, but no recognised striker and fatigue keep the draw very live
reasons_en: Chelsea's confirmed XI has no recognised striker – Estêvão, Palmer and Rogers lead the line with Joao Pedro out
Chelsea played 120 minutes in the League Cup midweek and lost their last two league games, managing just 0.47 xG at home to Spurs
United are without Rashford (not in XI) and Šeško, but Fernandes, Cunha and Mbeumo all start, carry counter threat, and United lead the head-to-head
Referee Bankes averages 4.6 cards and 24 fouls per game; around 5 cards expected in a tight match
versions.key_changes_en: Home win cut from 51% to 44%, closer to the market: the confirmed XI has no striker, young keeper Penders starts, and midweek 120-minute fatigue; United win raised from 24% to 30%.

Spurs dominate possession and average ~6.5 corners; referee Oliver shows few cards

16363902.verdict: 主勝方向正確（44%，三個結果中最高），但預測估得太接近；般尼茅夫射正5比1，2-0贏得穩陣。
points: 勝和負方向命中；首選比分1-1落空，1-0和2-1都在候選內，實際是2-0。
角球預測主5.0、客4.3，實際4比4，偏差不大；上半場角球2比1也接近預測。
犯規12比15，列斯聯比預測多；黃牌2比2，和預測的2.0/1.9幾乎一樣，Salisbury 出牌少的判斷正確。
列斯聯控球56%，但xG只有0.67、射正1次，印證了「入球能力一般」的判斷；Evanilson 31分鐘入球後，列斯聯始終攻不破對方防線。
16363902.lesson: 狀態火熱的主隊對入球少的客隊時，應該調低和局機率，把1-0、2-0排在1-1前面。
16363902.verdict_en: Home-win direction was right (44%, the highest of the three outcomes), but the forecast was too close-call; Bournemouth won 2-0 comfortably with 5 shots on target to 1.
points_en: 1X2 direction hit; top scoreline 1-1 missed, 1-0 and 2-1 were listed, actual 2-0.
Corners forecast 5.0/4.3 vs actual 4/4, small error; 1H corners 2/1 also close.
Fouls 12/15, with Leeds above forecast; cards 2/2 almost exactly matched 2.0/1.9, confirming Salisbury's low card rate.
Leeds had 56% possession but only 0.67 xG and 1 shot on target, confirming their weak attack; after Evanilson's 31' goal they never broke Bournemouth down.
16363902.lesson_en: When an in-form home side meets a low-scoring visitor, cut the draw probability and rank 1-0/2-0 above 1-1.

16363903.verdict: 主勝方向命中（46%），但賓福特全場xG只有0.46，靠烏龍球和一次把握機會取勝，贏得幸運。
points: 勝和負方向正確，比分候選有1-0，實際2-0；30分鐘 Milenković 的烏龍球是模型無法預計的偶然事件。
犯規偏差最大：賓福特全場只犯規6次（預測12.8），森林犯規17次（預測12.5）；領先後主隊退守，追分的森林多犯規。
黃牌1比3，同樣是追分一方出牌多，總數4張和預測的4.2接近，但分佈錯了。
角球3比4，兩隊都低於預測的5.0，雙方都缺乏攻擊性，整場比賽很悶。
16363903.lesson: 早段領先的一方犯規和黃牌會明顯減少，追分一方增加；先入球的機會高時，犯規和黃牌預測應向落後一方傾斜。
16363903.verdict_en: Home-win call hit (46%), but Brentford produced only 0.46 xG and won via an own goal plus one finished chance – a fortunate win.
points_en: 1X2 direction right and 1-0 was among the scorelines, actual 2-0; Milenković's 30' own goal was a random event no model can foresee.
Fouls were the biggest miss: Brentford committed only 6 (forecast 12.8) and Forest 17 (forecast 12.5); the leading home side sat back while chasing Forest fouled more.
Cards 1/3 – again skewed to the chasing side; the total of 4 matched the 4.2 forecast but the split was wrong.
Corners 3/4, both under the 5.0 forecast; neither side was very attacking in a dull game.
16363903.lesson_en: The team that leads early fouls and gets booked much less while the chasing side does more; when one side is likely to score first, tilt foul/card forecasts toward the trailing team.

16363904.verdict: 賽前輕微看好切爾西的方向正確，但比分、犯規同黃牌都估得太保守；半場檢討時被曼聯上半場的 xG 誤導，反而轉向看淡切爾西，結果失準。
points: 勝負：賽前切爾西勝 44% 屬最大機會，方向命中；但三個熱門比分（1-1、2-1、1-2）都假設曼聯會入球，實際曼聯零入球，切爾西 2-0 贏。
下半場轉捩點是 50 分鐘 Rogers 開紀錄，之後 L. Martínez 在 59 分鐘和 63 分鐘連吃兩黃被逐，切爾西一分鐘後就由 Palmer 射入十二碼。紅牌加早段入球令比賽一面倒，模型完全看不到這類事件。
犯規和黃牌偏差最大：曼聯犯規 20 次（預測 11.8）、黃牌 6 張加 1 紅（預測 2.7）。全場合共 7 黃 1 紅，比原先估計的約 5 張還多；Bankes 執法偏嚴，加上落後一方追分時心急，牌數急升。
半場檢討太倚重上半場 xG（曼聯 1.01 對 0.28），把切爾西勝率降到 24%，忽略了切爾西主場控球佔優、陣容有較強的下半場調整能力；角球方面，上半場曼聯 6 對 3，最後全場卻是切爾西 8 對 7。
16363904.lesson: 遇上執法偏嚴的球證（例如 Bankes）而且雙方實力接近時，客隊的犯規和黃牌要估高一點；半場檢討不應單憑上半場 xG 大幅推翻賽前判斷，比分仍是 0-0 時，主隊的勝率不宜砍得太多。
16363904.verdict_en: The pre-match lean towards Chelsea was right, but the scoreline, fouls and cards were badly underestimated; the half-time update was swayed by United's first-half xG and wrongly turned against Chelsea.
points_en: Result: Chelsea at 44% was the most likely outcome and it came true, but all three top scorelines (1-1, 2-1, 1-2) had United scoring, while the actual result was a 2-0 Chelsea clean sheet.

The turning point came after the break: Rogers scored on 50', L. Martínez was sent off for two yellows (59', 63'), and Palmer converted a penalty a minute later. The early second-half goal plus the red card made the game one-sided, and the model cannot see events like these.

Fouls and cards had the biggest miss: United committed 20 fouls (predicted 11.8) and got 6 yellows plus a red (predicted 2.7). The match total of 7 yellows and 1 red was even above the ~5 cards expected. Bankes was strict, and United chased the game.

The half-time update leaned too heavily on United's first-half xG (1.01 vs 0.28) and cut Chelsea's win chance to 24%. It ignored Chelsea's home possession edge and their stronger ability to adjust in the second half. Corners also flipped: United led 6-3 at half-time, but Chelsea finished ahead 8-7.
16363904.lesson_en: With a strict referee like Bankes in a tight big-team match, push the away side's fouls and cards higher. At half-time, don't overturn the pre-match view on first-half xG alone; at 0-0, keep the home side's win probability from dropping too far.

16363905.verdict: 預測錯誤：賽前看好新特蘭（38%），結果考文垂以xG 0.71入3球，3-1大勝。
points: 考文垂xG只有0.71卻入了3球，射正4次入3球，臨門一腳遠超預期；新特蘭xG 1.65只入了一個十二碼。
半場預測0-0，實際2-0；Sakamoto 17分鐘早段入球打亂了「兩隊進攻都弱」的劇本。
考文垂犯規16次，遠多過預測的11.5，領先後以犯規拖慢節奏；Alderete 90分鐘才兩黃變紅，對賽果沒有影響。
角球4比4，和預測的4.2/4.8大致吻合，黃牌總數4張也接近。
16363905.lesson: 不要過度依賴市場看好客隊；兩隊進攻都弱時，和局及主隊勝的機率應該更接近，並保留一方臨門一腳異常好的可能。
16363905.verdict_en: Wrong call: Sunderland were favoured (38%), but Coventry turned 0.71 xG into three goals and won 3-1.
points_en: Coventry scored 3 from 4 shots on target on just 0.71 xG – huge finishing overperformance; Sunderland's 1.65 xG yielded only a penalty.
HT forecast 0-0, actual 2-0; Sakamoto's early 17' goal broke the 'both attacks weak' script.
Coventry committed 16 fouls vs 11.5 forecast, slowing the game once ahead; Alderete's second yellow came only at 90' and did not affect the result.
Corners 4/4 broadly matched 4.2/4.8, and total cards (4) were also close.
16363905.lesson_en: Don't lean too hard on a market-favoured away side; when both attacks are weak, keep draw and home-win probabilities closer and allow for a hot finishing day.

16363906.verdict: 2-2和局，賽前三個結果的機率很平均，可算大致合理；但半場時改判葉士域治58%勝出就錯了。
points: 賽前給和局28%、首選比分1-1，方向接近，實際是更多入球的2-2；半場改判客勝58%，忽略了侯城主場反撲的能力。
黃牌偏差最大：實際6張（3比3），預測4.3張；下半場出了5張牌，比賽到後段變得激烈。
角球侯城6個（預測4.4）、葉士域治3個（預測4.6）；落後的主隊在下半場追分時多開角球。
葉士域治控球62%、xG 1.02，但只射正3次，壓制未能轉化為優勢，McBurnie 和 Iroegbunam 10分鐘內連入兩球反超。
16363906.lesson: 半場時只領先一球、xG差距又不大，不應大幅調高領先一方的勝率；落後的主隊下半場角球和黃牌都會增加。
16363906.verdict_en: A 2-2 draw – the pre-match probabilities were fairly even and broadly reasonable, but the half-time switch to a 58% Ipswich win was wrong.
points_en: Pre-match gave the draw 28% with 1-1 as top scoreline, close in spirit; actual was a higher-scoring 2-2. The HT update to 58% away win ignored Hull's ability to fight back at home.
Cards were the biggest miss: 6 actual (3/3) vs 4.3 forecast; 5 came in the second half as the game got heated.
Corners: Hull 6 (forecast 4.4), Ipswich 3 (forecast 4.6) – the trailing home side won more corners while chasing.
Ipswich had 62% possession and 1.02 xG but only 3 shots on target; McBurnie and Iroegbunam then scored twice in 10 minutes to turn it around.
16363906.lesson_en: At half-time, a one-goal lead with a small xG gap should not push the leader's win probability up too far; a trailing home side's second-half corners and cards rise.

16363908.verdict: 大冷門：預測曼城勝出（55%），結果白禮頓靠 Ayari 11分鐘入球1-0贏。
points: 曼城射門21次、xG 1.92，入球數低於表現，而 Ayari 早段入球後白禮頓退守，這種偶然性模型看不到。
角球8比2，曼城比預測的6.2多、白禮頓比預測的4.0少；一方壓制時角球差距被低估，是已知偏差。
黃牌0比3，曼城預測1.5張卻一張都沒有；白禮頓領先也出了3張牌，因為長時間防守要犯規阻止反擊。
Pawson 預計每場5張黃牌，實際只有3張，全場犯規22次，也低於他平均的27次。
16363908.lesson: 強隊主場面對防守紮實的對手，勝率不宜高於55%；一方控球壓制時，角球預測要拉開差距，被壓制一方的角球要調低。
16363908.verdict_en: Big upset: Man City were favoured (55%) but Brighton won 1-0 through Ayari's 11th-minute goal.
points_en: City had 21 shots and 1.92 xG but scored nothing, while Brighton sat deep after Ayari's early goal – randomness the model cannot see.
Corners 8/2: City above the 6.2 forecast, Brighton well below 4.0; the corner gap is underestimated when one side dominates, a known bias.
Cards 0/3: City were forecast 1.5 but got none; Brighton still collected 3 while leading, as long spells of defending meant fouling to stop counters.
Pawson was expected to show about 5 yellows but showed 3, and total fouls (22) were below his 27 average.
16363908.lesson_en: Cap a big home favourite near 55% against a well-organised defence, and widen the predicted corner gap when one side dominates possession, cutting the pinned-back side's corners.

16363902.verdict: 般尼茅夫憑 Evanilson 31分鐘入球領先，上半場大致符合「主隊稍佔優」的預期，但半場比分預測0-0落空。
points: 半場比分預測0-0錯，主隊xG 0.63對0.41，入球期望值（0.65/0.4）與實際走勢相當接近
11分鐘列斯聯 Calvert-Lewin 有一次VAR判決，但比分仍是1-0，以比分為準；列斯聯控球53%，射門卻只得3次，威脅有限
犯規7對10，比預測多，主要是列斯聯偏多；黃牌1對1，與預測吻合，角球2對1略低於預測
16363902.headline: 列斯聯落後要壓上，般尼茅夫可以打反擊再添一球，主隊守住勝果的機會較大。
16363902.changes: 賽前主勝44%，現在升到62%，因為主隊已經領先；列斯聯上半場犯規已有10次，所以全場犯規上調；大2.5球機率下調，因為還要再入兩球。
16363902.verdict_en: Bournemouth lead through Evanilson's 31st-minute goal, roughly matching the 'home slight edge' view, but the 0-0 HT call missed.
points_en: 0-0 HT call wrong; xG 0.63 vs 0.41 was close to the expected 1H goals (0.65/0.4)
Leeds had a VAR moment with Calvert-Lewin on 11', but the score stands 1-0; Leeds had 53% possession but only 3 shots
Fouls 7 vs 10, above forecast, mostly from Leeds; yellows 1-1 as expected; corners 2-1 slightly under
16363902.headline_en: Leeds must push; Bournemouth can counter for a second and are favourites to hold on.
16363902.changes_en: Home win up from 44% to 62% after taking the lead; full-time fouls raised because Leeds already have 10; over 2.5 lowered since two more goals are needed.

16363903.verdict: 賓福特靠 Milenković 的烏龍球領先，但上半場是森林佔優，主隊xG只有0.15。
points: 半場比分預測0-0錯，入球來自烏龍球，不是賓福特打出來的機會
森林射門9對4，xG 0.41對0.15，符合賽前「森林運氣差多於實力差」的判斷
犯規只有3對7，遠低於預測的6.3/6.4；Milenković 烏龍之後再吃黃牌，角球2對2接近預測
16363903.headline: 森林追分會壓上，扳平機會不小；賓福特主要靠反擊和定位球。
16363903.changes: 主勝從46%升到55%，因為已經領先，但森林場面較好，所以沒有升太多；賓福特犯規少，全場犯規預測下調；森林角球上調。
16363903.verdict_en: Brentford lead via a Milenković own goal, but Forest were better; Brentford's xG was just 0.15.
points_en: 0-0 HT call wrong; the goal was an own goal, not a Brentford chance
Forest outshot them 9-4 (xG 0.41 vs 0.15), consistent with the 'unlucky, not bad' pre-match view
Fouls only 3 vs 7, far below the 6.3/6.4 forecast; Milenković booked after his own goal; corners 2-2 near forecast
16363903.headline_en: Forest will push and have a real chance to equalise; Brentford rely on counters and set pieces.
16363903.changes_en: Home win up from 46% to 55% only, given Forest's edge in play; Brentford fouls lowered; Forest corners raised.

16363904.verdict: 上半場曼聯明顯較有威脅，xG 1.01 對 0.28、絕佳機會 3 對 1，但比分仍是 0-0；半場比分預測命中，入球、角球和黃牌部分則有偏差。
points: 半場 0-0 預測命中。不過賽前預計上半場切爾西入球 0.7 球、曼聯 0.5 球，實際走勢相反：曼聯 9 次射門、3 次絕佳機會，xG 1.01；切爾西沒有正選中鋒，xG 只有 0.28，印證了賽前對其入球效率的擔心。34 分鐘 Cunha 有一次 VAR 判決事件，數據標示為「入球有效」，但提供的半場比分仍是 0-0，兩者有矛盾，本檢討按 0-0 處理。
角球低估了曼聯：實際 3 比 6，預測是 2.5 比 2.1。正如已知偏差，一方佔優勢時角球容易被低估，雖然控球率接近五五波，但曼聯的進攻次數明顯較多。
犯規分佈預測錯：實際 3 比 8，曼聯犯規遠多於預測的 5.6，切爾西則少於 5.3。兩隊合共 11 次，與預測總數 10.9 接近。數據中沒有黃牌紀錄，所以預計 1.9 張黃牌偏高；Bankes 上半場比預期寬鬆。
16363904.headline: 下半場只剩 45 分鐘，切爾西前線欠缺破門手段，曼聯憑反擊和機會質素稍佔上風；小球和和局機會最大，若有入球，曼聯先入的機會較高。
16363904.changes: 賽前切爾西勝和負為 44/26/30，現改為 24/38/38。原因：半場 0-0 只剩半場時間，和局機率大增；上半場 xG 及絕佳機會都是曼聯佔優，切爾西又沒有中鋒，所以把主勝大幅調低。最可能比分由 1-1 改為 0-0 / 0-1。全場角球由 5.2 比 4.6 改為 6.0 比 8.5，因曼聯上半場已有 6 個。全場犯規由 11.0 比 11.8 改為 8.5 比 13.5，按上半場的犯規分佈調整。上半場沒有黃牌，全場黃牌由約 5 張調低至約 3 張，但 Bankes 一向執法嚴厲，下半場膠著時仍可能多出牌。
16363904.verdict_en: Manchester United were clearly more threatening in the first half (xG 1.01 vs 0.28, big chances 3 vs 1), yet it is 0-0. The half-time score prediction was right, but the goal, corner and card details were off.
points_en: The 0-0 half-time call was correct. However, we expected Chelsea to create more (0.7 vs 0.5 first-half goals), and the opposite happened: United had 9 shots, 3 big chances and 1.01 xG. Chelsea, without a recognised striker, managed only 0.28 xG, confirming the pre-match worry about their finishing. There was a VAR incident involving Cunha on 34' that the data labels 'goal awarded', but the half-time score given is still 0-0. The two conflict, and this review treats the score as 0-0.

Corners underrated United: 3-6 actual vs 2.5-2.1 predicted. This matches the known bias that corners get underestimated when one side dominates. Possession was roughly even, but United attacked far more often.

The foul split was wrong: 3-8 actual. United fouled much more than the predicted 5.6 and Chelsea less than 5.3, although the combined total of 11 was close to the predicted 10.9. No yellow cards are recorded, so the forecast of about 1.9 was too high; Bankes was more lenient than expected.
16363904.headline_en: With 45 minutes left, Chelsea lack a cutting edge up front, while United's counter-attacks and better chances give them a slight edge. A low-scoring game or a draw is most likely; if anyone scores, United are more likely to get the first goal.
16363904.changes_en: The Chelsea win/draw/United win split moved from 44/26/30 to 24/38/38. Reason: at 0-0 with only half the game left, a draw becomes much more likely, and United led on xG and big chances while Chelsea have no striker, so the home-win chance was cut sharply. The most likely score changed from 1-1 to 0-0 / 0-1. Full-time corners changed from 5.2-4.6 to 6.0-8.5 because United already have 6. Full-time fouls changed from 11.0-11.8 to 8.5-13.5 to follow the first-half split. With no yellows in the first half, the card total drops from about 5 to about 3, though Bankes is usually strict and could still book more players in a tight second half.

16363905.verdict: 考文垂上半場兩球領先，賽前看好新特蘭的判斷明顯錯了。
points: 半場比分預測0-0錯，Sakamoto 17分鐘、Awoniyi 37分鐘入球，xG只有0.39，射門把握很高
新特蘭控球53%，xG卻只有0.29，只有1腳射正，進攻疲弱
犯規7對5，接近預測；考文垂 Torp 早段黃牌，角球3對1，比預測更偏向主隊
16363905.headline: 新特蘭要壓上搶分，考文垂可以退守反擊，兩球優勢應該守得住。
16363905.changes: 賽前客勝38%最高，現在主勝升到80%；全場大2.5球大幅上調，因為只差一球；新特蘭落後要壓上，角球上調。
16363905.verdict_en: Coventry lead 2-0 at the break; the pre-match lean towards Sunderland was clearly wrong.
points_en: 0-0 HT call wrong; Sakamoto (17') and Awoniyi (37') scored from only 0.39 xG, very clinical finishing
Sunderland had 53% possession but just 0.29 xG and 1 shot on target
Fouls 7 vs 5 near forecast; Torp booked early; corners 3-1, more home-leaning than forecast
16363905.headline_en: Sunderland must chase; Coventry can sit deep and counter, and should hold a two-goal lead.
16363905.changes_en: Away win was the pre-match favourite at 38%; now home win is 80%; over 2.5 raised sharply since one more goal does it; Sunderland corners raised as they chase.

16363906.verdict: 葉士域治控球69%，壓制侯城，F. Luís 22分鐘入球領先。
points: 半場比分預測0-0錯，葉士域治控球和大機會（2對0）都佔上風，侯城沒有射正
侯城如賽前所料排低位防守，但沒能守住0-0，xG只有0.17
角球3對3，比預測略高；犯規6對5，接近預測；黃牌是客隊 Palacios 吃，不是預測偏多的侯城
16363906.headline: 侯城落後要打開陣型，葉士域治會有更多反擊空間，但他們防守常有漏洞，侯城仍有扳平機會。
16363906.changes: 客勝從37%升到58%，因為葉士域治已經領先，而且控制大局；侯城追分要壓上，角球上調；侯城黃牌比賽前預測少。
16363906.verdict_en: Ipswich dominated with 69% possession and lead through F. Luís on 22'.
points_en: 0-0 HT call wrong; Ipswich led on possession and big chances (2-0), Hull had no shot on target
Hull sat deep as expected but couldn't hold 0-0; xG just 0.17
Corners 3-3, slightly above forecast; fouls 6-5 near forecast; the yellow went to Ipswich's Palacios, not card-prone Hull
16363906.headline_en: Hull must open up, leaving Ipswich more counter space, but Ipswich's leaky defence keeps an equaliser possible.
16363906.changes_en: Away win up from 37% to 58% with Ipswich ahead and in control; Hull corners raised as they chase; Hull cards lowered.

16363908.verdict: 白禮頓 Ayari 11分鐘入球，客隊領先；曼城控球55%但只有1腳射正，賽前預測半場1-0主隊領先錯了。
points: 半場比分預測1-0錯，xG 0.55對0.58，曼城預測上半入球0.9是高估了
曼城射門7對3，但白禮頓大機會2對1，反擊更有效率
角球3對1、犯規3對6，方向與預測一致；白禮頓 C. Andrés 已有黃牌，下半場要收斂
16363908.headline: 曼城會全力壓上，Haaland 和 Doku 會有更多機會，白禮頓要頂住壓力，再找反擊機會。
16363908.changes: 主勝從55%降到26%，客勝升到46%，因為白禮頓領先而且機會質素不差；曼城追分壓上，角球上調到8.5；白禮頓要拖延和防守，犯規和黃牌偏多。
16363908.verdict_en: Brighton lead through Ayari on 11'; City had 55% possession but one shot on target, so the 1-0 home HT call was wrong.
points_en: 1-0 HT call wrong; xG 0.55 vs 0.58, City's 0.9 expected 1H goals was too high
City outshot them 7-3, but Brighton had more big chances (2-1) and were more efficient on the break
Corners 3-1 and fouls 3-6 match the forecast direction; C. Andrés is on a yellow and must be careful
16363908.headline_en: City will throw everything forward with Haaland and Doku; Brighton must absorb pressure and hit on the break.
16363908.changes_en: Home win cut from 55% to 26%, away win up to 46% with Brighton ahead and creating good chances; City corners raised to 8.5 as they chase; Brighton fouls and cards stay high as they defend and slow the game.
